title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add more foods and activities to the Session 1 tables
body:
## Problem
The tables have only six foods and six activities, and local foods are missing.

## Context
Students relate better to familiar foods. Values must be rounded textbook values labelled approximate, with a source.

## Expected outcome
At least five more foods and three more activities with sources in a comment.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each value has a source and is labelled approximate
- [ ] Checkpoint still prints PASS

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a Session 4: fit the model to noisy weigh-ins
body:
## Problem
The first roadmap milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Session 3 shows uncertainty but cannot reduce it.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3, with the safety note that this is general education.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a sensitivity ranking to Session 3
body:
## Problem
Session 3 reports only the combined spread of the 12-week result.

## Context
Students ask which error matters most: food log, BMR estimate or portion size.

## Expected outcome
A function that ranks the error sources by their share of the output variance, with a figure.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Shares add up to between 0.9 and 1.0
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: animated mass trajectory with an uncertainty band
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows energy bars, a mass curve approaching its steady state and an uncertainty band; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] GIF of at most 3 MB with at most 60 frames
- [ ] Short write-up of your method and its limits

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
